intro.h2: Tile work where the details get settled before the first cut
paragraphs: Antonio's Tile is a Ypsilanti tile contractor that has carried the same name since 1977. Most of the work is in bathrooms: walk-in showers, full bath remodels and master shower re-tiles. The crew also sets kitchen backsplashes, countertops, mosaics and tile floors.

What reviewers notice is the planning. Antonio sits down with you before any tile goes up and settles the small choices that make a shower work every day: where the recessed shelves go, which pattern runs on the walls, how the trim finishes the edges. Already picked your tile at Home Depot, The Tile Shop or Lowe's? Antonio's Tile installs it, so you can shop where you like and still have a tile specialist set it.

services.h2: What an Ypsilanti tile contractor can do for your home

items.name: Shower tile and shower re-tiles
items.blurb: New walk-in showers and full re-tiles of tired master bath showers. Recessed niches are planned with you so shampoo and soap have a home, and floor tile is set to the drain. One reviewer asked for her shower re-tile and said she got the shower she envisioned.

image.alt: White subway tile shower wall with three recessed niches trimmed in brass

items.name: Bathroom remodeling
items.blurb: From the floor up: tile floors, tub and shower walls, and the finishing around the vanity. Projects range from classic checkerboard floors to bold navy wall tile with brass fixtures. Google reviewers mention bathroom remodels more than any other job.

image.alt: Bathroom with grey and white checkerboard floor tile, dark cherry vanity and glass shower

items.name: Kitchen backsplashes
items.blurb: A backsplash changes how a whole kitchen feels. Antonio's Tile has set deep navy herringbone behind a farmhouse sink and glossy white subway tile above stone counters. Backsplash installation is one of the jobs Google reviewers call out by name.

image.alt: Kitchen with navy herringbone tile backsplash, white shaker cabinets and white countertop by the window

items.name: Countertops
items.blurb: Countertops are part of the kitchen and bath work, so the counter and the tile above it can be planned together. Photos show speckled stone counters finished with a white subway backsplash and under-cabinet outlets cut in clean.

image.alt: Speckled stone kitchen countertop with glossy white subway tile backsplash and white cabinets

items.name: Mosaics and tile floors
items.blurb: Patterned cement-look floors, hexagon shower pans and hand-set mosaic medallions. In September 2026 Antonio's Tile shared a mosaic medallion set into a white subway wall. Floors and grout work also come up again and again in Google reviews.

image.alt: Tile installer setting a blue and white mosaic medallion into a white subway tile wall

items.title: The details are agreed up front
items.text: A reviewer said Antonio brought her in to go over recess shelving, tile pattern and trim before moving forward, so the finished shower matched what she pictured.

items.title: They show up when they say
items.text: Matt R. wrote that Tony and Gino showed up when they said they would and worked hard until the job was done. The price was fair and the work was excellent, in his words.

items.title: Bring the tile you already chose
items.text: Antonio's Tile installs tile bought from The Home Depot, The Tile Shop and Lowe's, so you can shop where you like and still get a dedicated tile installer.

items.title: A name around since 1977
items.text: The Antonio's Tile logo and Facebook page both say since 1977. Today the business holds a 4.7 star rating from 29 Google reviews.

about.h2: Antonio and Gino, on the job
about.text: Antonio's Tile works out of Eastlawn Avenue in Ypsilanti and has used the same name since 1977. The people homeowners meet are Antonio and Gino, the pair reviewers name when they talk about their new showers and bathrooms. Antonio is the one who sits down with you to go over niches, layout and trim, and he answers reviews himself, often signing off with God bless. The crew installs the tile you pick from the big stores and specialty shops, and finishes with the mosaic and pattern work you see in their photos.

process.h2: How a tile job with Antonio's Tile works

steps.title: Call for a free estimate
steps.text: Call (734) 623-3274 to set up a free estimate. Google lists the business as open seven days a week.

steps.title: Choose your tile
steps.text: Pick tile at The Home Depot, The Tile Shop, Lowe's or anywhere you like. Antonio's Tile installs tile from all three.

steps.title: Go over the details
steps.text: Before work starts, Antonio goes over niches, recessed shelving, tile pattern and trim with you so the plan is clear.

steps.title: Install and clean up
steps.text: The crew sets the tile and grout and works through until the job is done, as reviewers describe.

steps.title: Let it cure
steps.text: Antonio's Tile recommends waiting 24 to 48 hours before walking on freshly installed tile so tiles do not shift or crack the grout.

items.name: Kristy S.
items.text: Antonio and Gino did an excellent job on my master bath shower re-tile. Antonio is an excellent communicator and is always focused on ensuring that every detail is done right. He brought me in to go over details before moving forward (e.g., recess shelving, tile pattern, trim)—focused on making sure I got the shower I envisioned. And I did! Pricing is reasonable, work is high quality, and Antonio and Gino are both wonderful to work with. Highly recommend!

service_area.h2: Tile work in Ypsilanti, Ann Arbor and Washtenaw County
service_area.text: Antonio's Tile is based at 2770 Eastlawn Ave in Ypsilanti, Michigan. Its Facebook posts name Ypsilanti Township and Ann Arbor as places it works, and tag its finished projects in Washtenaw County, Michigan. Most jobs are showers, bathrooms and kitchen backsplashes in homes around these towns. If you live nearby and are not sure whether your street is covered, call (734) 623-3274 and ask before you book an estimate.

items.a: Yes. Antonio's Tile advertises free estimates on its Facebook page and on its call-today graphic. Call (734) 623-3274 to set one up, and describe the shower, bathroom, backsplash or floor you have in mind so Antonio knows what to look at when he comes out.

items.q: Can you install tile I already bought?
items.a: Yes. Antonio's Tile says it installs tile from The Home Depot, The Tile Shop and Lowe's Home Improvement. Bring your choice to the estimate, or the boxes if you already bought them, and Antonio can talk through layout, niches, pattern and trim for that tile before work starts.

The shop is at 2770 Eastlawn Ave, Ypsilanti, MI 48197. Facebook posts name Ypsilanti Township, Ann Arbor and Washtenaw County as the area it works in. For a home anywhere else nearby, call (734) 623-3274 and ask whether your address is in range before booking.

Google lists Sunday to Thursday 7 AM to 8 PM, Friday 7:30 AM to 8 PM, and Saturday open 24 hours, so there is a window every day of the week. The number to call is (734) 623-3274, the same number printed on the Antonio's Tile estimate graphic.

items.q: How soon can we walk on the new tile?
items.a: Antonio's Tile recommends waiting 24 to 48 hours before walking on freshly installed tile. That gives the mortar time to set so tiles do not shift, sink or crack the grout lines. Ask at the end of your job when your new floor or shower pan is ready to use.
